# code for 16S sequencing data

```
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --partition=compute
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --mem=20gb
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=20
#SBATCH --time=04:35:00

module load anaconda/5.1
source activate qiime2-2018.8

echo merging and clustering
qiime dada2 denoise-paired \
    --i-demultiplexed-seqs paired-end-demux.qza \
    --p-n-threads 20 \
    --p-trunc-q 2 \
    --p-trim-left-f 19 \
    --p-trim-left-r 20 \
    --p-trunc-len-f 200 \
    --p-trunc-len-r 160 \
    --p-max-ee 5 \
    --p-n-reads-learn 1000000 \
    --p-chimera-method consensus \
    --o-table asv_table.qza \
    --o-representative-sequences rep-seqs.qza \
    --o-denoising-stats ASVs3/stats-dada2.qza

echo classifying taxa
qiime feature-classifier classify-sklearn \
    --i-classifier ../21Oct21/tagseq-qiime2-snakemake/silva_all.qza \
    --i-reads rep-seqs.qza \
    --o-classification asv_tax_sklearn.qza


qiime tools export --input-path asv_table.qza \
    --output-path asv_table

biom convert -i asv_table/feature-table.biom -o asv_table/asv-table.tsv --to-tsv

qiime tools export  --input-path asv_tax_sklearn.qza --output-path asv_tax_dir

qiime phylogeny align-to-tree-mafft-fasttree \
    --i-sequences rep-seqs.qza \
    --output-dir mafft-fasttree-output

```

# Import 16S Data

```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
numbs=read.csv(file='datafiles/copy_number.csv',
               header=T)
number=numbs$x
x<-read.csv(file='datafiles/asv-table.csv',
            header=TRUE,row.names=1)
x2=sweep(x, 1, number, "/") # divide asvs by 16S gene copy number
x2=ceiling(x2) # round it

OTU = otu_table(x2, taxa_are_rows=T)
taxa<-read.csv(file='datafiles/taxonomy.csv',
               header=TRUE,row.names=1)
t<-as.matrix(taxa)
tax2<-tax_table(t)
map<-import_qiime_sample_data("datafiles/sampling_batch_exp3_combined.txt")
tree=read.newick("datafiles/tree.nwk")
phyo1 = phyloseq(OTU, tax2,map,tree)
 # 1238 ASVs
phyo1 = subset_taxa(phyo1, !Order=="Chloroplast")
 #  1125, removed 113 that were chloroplasts
phyo1 = subset_taxa(phyo1, !Family=="Mitochondria")
 # 1104, removed 21 mitochondria
phyo1=subset_taxa(phyo1, !Phylum =="Cyanobacteria")
 # 1089, removed 15 cyanobacteria
phyo1=subset_taxa(phyo1, !Phylum =="")
 # 1078, removed 19 no assignment to phyla level

phyo_frac=subset_samples(phyo1, Isotope !="NA")
phyo_frac <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phyo_frac) > 0, phyo_frac)

```

```{r}
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_any(-feature_id, ~ .x >= 5))

qsip_obj5 <- qsip_data(
  source_data  = source,

  feature_data = qsip_feature_data(feature_df, type = "counts")
)

pairs <- get_comparison_groups(qsip_obj5,
                               group = "treatment",
                               isotope = "isotope",
                               source_mat_id = "source_mat_id") |>
  dplyr::transmute(treatment, unlabeled = `12C`, labeled = `13C`)


```
#### find where the mark is between the light and heavy band

in order to see if there is differences in the number of 16S copies of enriched taxa, we first find out where the light and heavy deviates in our runs. This script finds where 95 % of the light RNA falls in the gradient. The output is where that 95% line is (on the figure) and the percent of RNA remaining in the gradient that is not in the 95%. 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# rename levels in the buoyant density files 
lvl <- c("single-substrate batch", "multi-substrate batch", "multi-substrate chemostat")
## read in the data for each substrate
bd <- read.csv("datafiles/exp3_bd.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    isotope   = ifelse(Isotope == "C12", "12C", "13C"),
    gradient  = paste(Culture, Substrate, Isotope, sep = "_"),
    treatment = paste0(tolower(Substrate), "-substrate ", tolower(Culture)),
    treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c(lvl, setdiff(unique(treatment), lvl))),
    sequenced = Sequenced == "Y"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Conc), !is.na(BD)) %>%
  arrange(gradient, BD) %>%
  group_by(gradient) %>%
  mutate(rel_amt   = Conc / sum(Conc),
                ratio_max = Conc / max(Conc)) %>%
  ungroup()

count(bd, treatment, isotope, sequenced)

# For each 12C treatment, find the point in which 95% of the RNA lies in the light. This is the cutoff for the heavy/light bands for which we will calculate the differences in number of 16S copies from the light to dark 
cutoffs <- bd %>%
  filter(isotope == "12C") %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  mutate(lighter_cum = cumsum(rel_amt) - rel_amt) %>%
  summarize(
    heavy_cutoff  = (max(BD[lighter_cum < 0.95]) + min(BD[lighter_cum >= 0.95])) / 2,
    pct_12C_heavy = 100 * sum(rel_amt[lighter_cum >= 0.95]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cutoffs


cutoffs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(heavy_cutoff = round(heavy_cutoff, 4)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# plotting 
ggplot(bd, aes(x = ratio_max, y = BD, colour = isotope, group = gradient)) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sequenced), size = 2, fill = "white") +
  geom_hline(data = cutoffs, aes(yintercept = heavy_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("12C" = "grey60", "13C" = "black"),
                      labels = c(expression({}^12*C), expression({}^13*C))) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 21, "TRUE" = 16),
                     labels = c("FALSE" = "No", "TRUE" = "Yes")) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment) +
  labs(x = "Ratio of Maximum Quantity", y = "Buoyant Density (g/mL)",
       colour = "Isotope", shape = "Sequenced") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")




```

#### find fractionation noise threshold
Following the protocol from this paper [Sieradzki et al 2020](https://doi.org/10.1128/msystems.00151-20), we are going to find the variability of taxon density shifts in teh 12C. This is the tube to to tube or fractionation variability. So how much an ASV differs in their 12C distribution from one tube to another. This is measured as the median of 2 times the standard deviation of the unlabelled weighted average density (WAD). so this script:

1. finds the top 100 ASVs in your 12C gradients
2. finds shared ASVs in teh top 100 (in my case 87)
3. calculates the differences in the 12C peaks of those ASVs between the different gradients 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)  
# get the sequenced 12C fractions
samp_wad <- get_dataframe(sample_object) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, source_mat_id, gradient_pos_density, gradient_pos_rel_amt) %>%
  dplyr::filter(source_mat_id %in% pairs$unlabeled)

# get the ASVs and put them in long formate
feat_long <- feature_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-feature_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(samp_wad, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(tube_rel = if (sum(count) > 0) count / sum(count) * gradient_pos_rel_amt else 0) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
# only look at the batch tubes
feat_long=subset(feat_long, source_mat_id !="MCP_5MC2" )

# find the top 100
top100 <- feat_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(total, n = 100) %>%
  dplyr::pull(feature_id)
# find the shared ASVs in the top 100 (87) and then calculate 2 times the standard deviation of the WAD 
sd_per_asv <- feat_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature_id %in% top100) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_id, source_mat_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(WAD = sum(gradient_pos_density * tube_rel) / sum(tube_rel),
                   .groups = "drop") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(WAD)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= 2) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(sd2 = 2 * sd(WAD), .groups = "drop")

```


```{r}
## lets double check this worked
sd_sort <- sd_per_asv %>%
    arrange(sd2)

example_asv1=sd_sort$feature_id[1]
example_asv2=sd_sort$feature_id[87]

ex_dist <- feat_long %>%
  filter(feature_id == example_asv1)
ex_wad <- ex_dist |>
  dplyr::group_by(source_mat_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(WAD = sum(gradient_pos_density * tube_rel) / sum(tube_rel),
                   .groups = "drop")
ggplot(ex_dist, aes(x = gradient_pos_density, y = tube_rel)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(data = ex_wad, aes(xintercept = WAD), linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ source_mat_id, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Small standard deviation in WAD, keep",
       x = "Buoyant density (g/mL)",
       y = "Relative abundance in tube") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)


ex_dist <- feat_long %>%
  filter(feature_id == example_asv2)
ex_wad <- ex_dist |>
  dplyr::group_by(source_mat_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(WAD = sum(gradient_pos_density * tube_rel) / sum(tube_rel),
                   .groups = "drop")
ggplot(ex_dist, aes(x = gradient_pos_density, y = tube_rel)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(data = ex_wad, aes(xintercept = WAD), linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ source_mat_id, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Large standard deviation, will be cut",
       x = "Buoyant density (g/mL)",
       y = "Relative abundance in tube") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

shift_threshold <- median(sd_per_asv$sd2, na.rm = TRUE)

shift_threshold    # g/mL
nrow(sd_per_asv)   # ASVs contributing to the threshold

```

#### run qSIP2
must be in at least 3 fractions from labelled and unlaebelled 
```{r, eval=TRUE}
batch_unlab <- c("CA12-24", "GL12-24")

unlab_list <- lapply(pairs$treatment, function(trt) {
  if (grepl("^batch", trt)) batch_unlab else pairs$unlabeled[pairs$treatment == trt]
})

qsip_by_trt <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
  run_feature_filter(qsip_obj5,
    unlabeled_source_mat_ids = unlab_list[[i]],
    labeled_source_mat_ids   = pairs$labeled[i],
    min_unlabeled_sources    = 1,
    min_labeled_sources      = 1,
    min_unlabeled_fractions  = 3,
    min_labeled_fractions    = 3,
    group = pairs$treatment[i],
    quiet = TRUE
  ) |>
    run_resampling(resamples = 1000, with_seed = 17, allow_failures = TRUE,
                   progress = FALSE, quiet = TRUE) %>%
    run_EAF_calculations()
})
names(qsip_by_trt) <- pairs$treatment

# get EAF
eaf <- summarize_EAF_values(qsip_by_trt, confidence = 0.95) %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment = group, feature_id, observed_EAF, lower, upper, pval,
                unlabeled_sources)
eaf
range(eaf$lower)
range(eaf$upper)

eaf_df <- summarize_EAF_values(qsip_by_trt, confidence = 0.95) %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment = group, feature_id, observed_EAF, lower, upper, pval,
                unlabeled_sources)
```
##### calculate the number of 16S copies enriched per treatmetn  
```{r}
std_length_nt <- 465   # length (nt) of the RNA standard used for the qPCR curve
frac_vol_ml   <- 1     # fraction volume in mL (1 = copies per mL)
avogadro      <- 6.02214076e23

## calculate the shift between heavy and light for each ASV
shift_df <- lapply(names(qsip_by_trt), function(trt) {
  get_EAF_data(qsip_by_trt[[trt]]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(observed == TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(treatment = trt, feature_id,
                     W_unlab = W_unlab_mean, W_lab = W_lab_mean,
                     shift = W_lab_mean - W_unlab_mean)
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

# calculate the number of 16S copies per fraction 
bd <- read.csv("datafiles/exp3_bd.csv") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(copies = Conc * 1e-9 * avogadro / (std_length_nt * 320.5 + 159) * frac_vol_ml) %>%
  dplyr::select(seq_id, copies)
# get sample ids
samp <- get_dataframe(sample_object) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, source_mat_id) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::select(pairs, treatment, source_mat_id = labeled),
                    by = "source_mat_id")



# 1) calcualtes number of asvs copies per fraciton, 
# 2) sum those to get total_copies, 
# 3) get eaf estimates and confidence intervals (upper and lower) and WAD shift
# 4) sees if an ASV is enriched if it is greater than the tube variability (0.002877644 g/mL)
asv_shift <- feature_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-feature_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(samp, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(bd, by = c("sample_id" = "seq_id")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(asv_copies = if (sum(count) > 0) count / sum(count) * copies else 0) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment, feature_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total_copies = sum(asv_copies), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(eaf_df,   by = c("treatment", "feature_id")) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(shift_df, by = c("treatment", "feature_id")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    enriched        = shift > shift_threshold,
    enriched_copies = ifelse(enriched, total_copies, 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(treatment, feature_id, W_unlab, W_lab, shift, observed_EAF,
                lower, upper, pval, enriched, total_copies, enriched_copies) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(treatment, dplyr::desc(shift))

asv_shift


asv_shift %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_asvs              = dplyr::n(),
    n_enriched          = sum(enriched),
    enriched_copies     = sum(enriched_copies),
    total_copies        = sum(total_copies),
    pct_enriched_copies = 100 * enriched_copies / total_copies,
    .groups = "drop"
  )



```
note taxa are considered enriched if the shift is greater than the variation between tubes (shift > shift_threshold)


This shows the cutoff due ot variation that were killed

```{r}
pair_12C <- data.frame(treatment     = c("batch_carbon", "batch_glucose", "Chemo_carbon"),
                       source_mat_id = c("CA12-24", "GL12-24", "MCP_5MC2"))

copies_12C <- feature_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-feature_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(get_dataframe(sample_object) %>%
                      dplyr::select(sample_id, source_mat_id) %>%
                      dplyr::inner_join(pair_12C, by = "source_mat_id"),
                    by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(bd, by = c("sample_id" = "seq_id")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(asv_copies = count / sum(count) * copies) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment, feature_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(copies_12C = sum(asv_copies), .groups = "drop")

copies_bar <- asv_shift %>%
  dplyr::left_join(copies_12C, by = c("treatment", "feature_id")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(copies_12C, total_copies), names_to = "isotope", values_to = "copies") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(isotope = ifelse(isotope == "copies_12C", "12C", "13C")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment, isotope, enriched) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(copies = sum(copies, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment, isotope) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * copies / sum(copies)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(status = ifelse(enriched, "Enriched", "Not enriched"))

ggplot(copies_bar, aes(x = isotope, y = pct, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "#2E8B57", "Not enriched" = "#C0392B")) +
  facet_wrap(~ treatment) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of 16S rRNA copies", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")



```
##### remove outlier ASVs (12C vs 13C abundance mismatch)

Because each treatment has a single 12C and a single 13C gradient started from the same inoculum, an ASV should make up a similar share of total 16S rRNA copies in both tubes. ASVs whose share differs more than 10-fold between the paired gradients are usually present at trace levels in one tube, so their WAD rests on a few reads and the density shift is unreliable. We excluded these ASVs. 

```{r}
# ---- tube totals ----
tot_12C <- copies_12C %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(tot_12C = sum(copies_12C))

tot_13C <- samp %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(bd, by = c("sample_id" = "seq_id")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(tot_13C = sum(copies))

# ---- remove >10-fold mismatches ----
check <- asv_shift %>%
  dplyr::left_join(copies_12C, by = c("treatment", "feature_id")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tot_12C, by = "treatment") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tot_13C, by = "treatment") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(fold_diff = pmax(total_copies / tot_13C, copies_12C / tot_12C) /
                            pmin(total_copies / tot_13C, copies_12C / tot_12C))

sum(check$fold_diff > 10)   # ASVs excluded

asv_final <- check %>%
  dplyr::filter(fold_diff <= 10)

# ---- final summary per treatment ----
final_summary <- asv_final |>
  dplyr::group_by(treatment) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_asvs              = dplyr::n(),
    n_enriched          = sum(enriched),
    pct_enriched_copies = 100 * sum(enriched_copies) / sum(total_copies),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(final_summary)

asv_results <- asv_final |>
  dplyr::select(treatment, feature_id, shift, observed_EAF, lower, upper, pval,
                enriched, total_copies, enriched_copies) |>
  dplyr::arrange(treatment, dplyr::desc(observed_EAF))

asv_enriched <- asv_results |>
  dplyr::filter(enriched)

asv_final_res=asv_enriched
```

```{r batch-bb2, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dpi=300, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
multi=subset(incorp_only, Substrate=="multi" & Culture=="batch")
single=subset(incorp_only, Substrate=="single" & Culture=="batch")

# ---- shared batch incorporators, with each treatment's CI ----

  single[, c("feature_id", "A", "lower", "upper", "Class", "copy_number")],
  multi[,  c("feature_id", "A", "lower", "upper")],
  by = "feature_id", suffixes = c("_single", "_multi")
)
both$Single <- both$A_single
both$Multi  <- both$A_multi

custom_colors_class=c("Acidimicrobiia" ="#f21277",
                      "Actinobacteria" ="#a02016",
                      "Alphaproteobacteria" ="#ffb659",
                      "Bacteroidia" = "#48591c",
                      "Other" = 'gray',
                      "Deltaproteobacteria" ="#01a34a",
                      "Gammaproteobacteria" ="#7bc6ff",
                      "Planctomycetacia" ="#00539e",
                      "Verrucomicrobiae" ="#6868f2")

both$Class_ag = factor(both$Class_ag, levels = names(custom_colors_class))

# ---- regression stats for the annotation ----
summary(lm(Single ~ Multi, data = both))
nrow(both)

ggplot(both, aes(x=as.numeric(A_multi), y=as.numeric(A_single),  color=Class_ag)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_single, ymax = upper_single), width = 0, alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_point(size=as.numeric(both$copy_number), alpha=0.8) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.8), ylim = c(0, 0.8)) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, col='black',fullrange=TRUE) + 
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  xlab("EAF multi-substrate batch") +
  ylab("EAF single-substrate batch") +
#  annotate("text", label="R2 = 0.30 \n F = 25.38 \n p = 5.4 e-6", x=0.6, y=0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=custom_colors_class)


# new

lab4 <- paste0("R\u00b2 = ", sprintf("%.2f", fit4$r.squared),
               "\nF = ", sprintf("%.2f", fit4$fstatistic[1]),
              "\np = ", format(signif(coef(fit4)[2, 4], 2), scientific = TRUE))

  mutate(copy_number = as.numeric(as.character(copy_number)))
```

# Beta diversity metrics 
These are to see if there are differences in commuinty between the batch and chemostat because there was different innoculum and different sequencing centers 

## philr PCoA 

### pcoa of all ASVs
```{r pcoa-1, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dpi=300, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}

GP <- transform_sample_counts(phyo_frac, function(x) x+1)
phy_tree(GP) <- makeNodeLabel(phy_tree(GP), method="number", prefix='n')
name.balance(phy_tree(GP), tax_table(GP), 'n1')

otu.table <- t(otu_table(GP))
treefr <- phy_tree(GP)
metadata <- sample_data(GP)
tax <- tax_table(GP)

gp.philr <- philr(otu.table, treefr, 
                  part.weights='enorm.x.gm.counts', 
                  ilr.weights='blw.sqrt')


gp.dist <- dist(gp.philr, method="euclidean")
gp.pcoa <- ordinate(GP, 'PCoA', distance=gp.dist)

{par(mar=c(5,5,1,7))
  plot(gp.pcoa$vectors[,1],gp.pcoa$vectors[,2],
       pch=21,
       bg=as.factor(sample_data(GP)$Culture),
      xlab = "PCoA1 85.51%", ylab= "PCoA2 4.86%",xpd=F)
  ordiellipse(gp.pcoa$vectors,
              group=as.factor(sample_data(GP)$Culture),
              label=T,xpd=F,
              kind ='sd',conf=0.8)
  }

adonis2(gp.dist ~ as.factor(sample_data(GP)$Culture) +as.factor(sample_data(GP)$Substrate))

```

## SI Figure 3 relative abundance community
```{r}
comm_samples=c("5MC2", "9MC2", "SidersPond")
#just_comm=subset_samples(phyo1, SampleID1 %in% comm_samples)
#saveRDS(just_comm,'/Users/oliviaahern/Documents/GitHub/Sip_CopyNumber/datafiles/just_comm')
just_comm=readRDS('/Users/oliviaahern/Documents/GitHub/Sip_CopyNumber/datafiles/just_comm')

just_comm <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(just_comm) > 0, just_comm)
otu <- as(otu_table(just_comm), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(just_comm)) otu <- t(otu)
pa <- (otu > 0) * 1
colnames(pa) <- sample_data(just_comm)$SampleID1
# shared taxa between innoc and the community samples 
shared_mat <- t(pa) %*% pa
shared_mat

#sum(rowSums(pa) == ncol(pa))


glom=tax_glom(just_comm, "Genus")
abund=transform_sample_counts(glom, function(x) (x/sum(x)))
b1_melt <- psmelt(abund)

b1_summed <- b1_melt %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

shared_genera <- b1_summed %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Sample), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n == length(comm_samples)) %>%
  pull(Genus) %>%
  as.character()

b1_summed <- b1_summed %>%
  mutate(shared_genera = ifelse(Genus %in% shared_genera & !Genus %in% c("uncultured", "uncultured bacterium"),
                                as.character(Genus), "Not shared"))

shared_cols <- c(setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(shared_genera)), shared_genera),
                 "Not shared" = "grey85")

#b1_summed <- b1_summed %>%
#  mutate(Sample = fct_relevel(Sample,
#                              "Innoculum", "Coculture", "Algal-cell associated"))
library(ggalluvial)
b1_figure=ggplot(b1_summed, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, alluvium = Genus, stratum = Genus, fill = shared_genera)) +
  geom_flow(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_stratum() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom',
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
 # xlab("B1") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = shared_cols) +
  ylab("Relative Abundance")
b1_figure

#ggsave('comm_plot.svg',plot=b1_figure, dpi=300, height=6, width =5)
```
